notes.title: Play the new Frank and Drake demo now
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We just wanted to let you all know that we have just added a brand new demo for Frank and Drake for you to try. The demo is the [b]complete[/b] Day 1 of the game, ensuring that you get a nice feel for the game and the mystery that awaits. If you haven’t tried the game yet, make sure you check out the demo via the main store page. 

If you also haven’t yet seen our recent accolade trailer, here it is! 

[previewyoutube=7sOz1AkdgPU;full][trailer link][/previewyoutube]

We will also be at [url=https://www.indiedevday.es/en/ ]Indie Dev Day[/url] this weekend . If you are in Barcelona this weekend, be sure to drop by and say hello! I may even be able to help you with some ‘swapsies’ to help you complete your sticker album…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40293863/f477bacddf9ccc7aad1e0451fa574870092b4137.jpg[/img]

Many thanks

Appnormals Team

notes.title: Frank and Drake is available now
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We are very happy that Frank and Drake has launched today. 

If you want to find out more about the game you can watch this walkthrough video where take a deeper look. We'll introduce you to the characters, the setting and also look at some of the puzzles you can find... depending on the choices you make...  

Frank and Drake is out now!

We hope you enjoy playing the game, 

Appnormals Team

notes.title: Frank and Drake - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
We are very happy to confirm that Frank and Drake will be heading to Steam on 20th July! We have a brand new trailer that delves into the mystery surrounding our eponymous characters, Frank and Drake. Who is trying to communicate with our protagonists and what do they want?  

[previewyoutube=APQ0yC-P23s;full][/previewyoutube]

Don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game!

You can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/appnormals]Twitter[/url].

Thank you for all your support!

Appnormals Team

notes.title: Take an exclusive look at Frank and Drake with the developers
notes.content:
We take a deeper look at the game in this walkthrough video where we introduce you to the characters, the setting and also look at a few of the puzzles that you will need to solve… depending on the choices you make! 

In addition, we talk about the creative choices we made in the development of the game, as well as where our inspirations came from, as we strived to make something truly unique. We hope you enjoy finding out more about Frank and Drake and feel free to leave any questions you may have in the comments!

Don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game to keep up to date. We will have a series of posts in the run up to launch, taking a look at various aspects of the game, so be sure to wishlist and follow!

You can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/appnormals]Twitter[/url].

Thank you for all your support!

Appnormals Team

notes.title: Frankenstein and Dracula are roomies in this moody narrative adventure
notes.content:
"Dracula and Frankenstein are modern day 20-something flatmates who never see one another and only exchange sticky notes. Also they are both very sad. Also Dracula wears puple shades," is the kind of message I'd expect to see from one of my writing acquaintances with the timestamp [2:15am]. It's also the kind of thing I'd respond to with a "yes, do it," eager to find out exactly how the hell they would. That's the energy that I downloaded Frank And Drake's demo with, and it sure is a moody, somber narrative adventure about two unlikely housemates.

Read more
